integrity: Two self-contained integer programs verify the five complete labelled-set censuses. All calculations are exact and full finite enumerations; independent mathematical audit is not performed.
scientific_limitations: Exactly the five abelian isomorphism types of order sixteen; no extension to larger groups.
Not a count of all universal spectra per tile.
The cyclic existence case and the Z4-squared obstruction count are known; an unindexed equivalent five-group table remains a priority risk.
title: Universal complement spectra and subgroup obstructions in all sixteen-element abelian groups
